adminElo.title: Elo Management
adminElo.subtitle: Review Elo ledgers, resolve appeals, apply manual adjustments, and configure the dispute penalty.
adminElo.policyHelp: Applies to every dispute-resolution penalty. Percentage is computed on the user's current Elo; FixedPoints deducts a constant amount.
adminElo.resolveHelp: Choose a resolution. Full reversal restores the points deducted by the original transaction; partial correction and custom adjustment set a new delta. The correction is applied to the user's current Elo.
adminElo.deltaHelp: Number of points the user should lose or gain (use negative for a deduction).
adminElo.notePlaceholder: Explain the outcome to the user…
adminElo.resolveSuccess: Appeal resolved. The user's Elo was updated.
adminElo.adjustHelp: Increase or decrease a user's Elo. This is audited and notified to the user.
adminElo.adjustNoChange: The adjustment resulted in no change to the user's Elo.
